curation.notes: High-throughput DNA-curtain TIRF assay tracking fluorescently labeled T7 RNAP transcribing on lipid-anchored DNA aligned at nanofabricated chromium barriers; DNA is extended by buffer flow but no forces are applied or measured, so this is a marginal SMFS record. Only a short methods summary was available (details in SI).

acquisition_rate.note: 50 ms frame time (20 Hz camera frame rate)

evidence.snippet: Videos were recorded at 50 ms frame time and continuous illumination.
T7 RNAP was recombinantly expressed in E. coli, purified, and fluorescently labeled using a terminal ybbr-tag.

entities.name: Template DNA with T7 promoter sites (lipid-anchored, DNA curtain)

evidence.snippet: We introduced two different promoter sites on the template DNA and found that transcription initiation is directly influenced by the DNA shape parameters of the initiation region
